Tier D
Pattern 2 plus no app changes
• Full per-tenant relocation
• Filesystem-grained move
• Sub-minute cutover possible

Tier A
Pattern 1 plus no app changes
• Whole-pod migration only
• No per-tenant move
• Noisy-neighbour unmitigated

Tier B
Pattern 1 plus telemetry
• Identify hot tenant
• Operational alert
• Still no per-tenant move

Pattern 1 plus extraction

• Brief read-only window per move
